entries.name: Claude Code
entries.notes: Agentic coding tool that reads a repo, edits files, and runs commands in the terminal, IDE, desktop app, or browser.

entries.name: Claude Code subagents
entries.notes: Specialized workers inside one Claude Code session. Each returns a summary instead of filling the main context.

entries.name: Claude Code agent teams
entries.notes: Experimental teams of Claude Code sessions with a shared task list and messages between teammates. Off unless enabled.

entries.name: Claude Code dynamic workflows
entries.notes: Scripted orchestration that runs many Claude Code subagents and cross-checks their results.

entries.name: Claude Agent SDK
entries.notes: Python and TypeScript library for the Claude Code agent loop, tools, permissions, and sessions.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol
entries.notes: Open protocol for connecting agents to tools and data.

entries.name: MCP reference servers
entries.notes: Official reference MCP servers maintained with the protocol.

entries.name: GitHub MCP server
entries.notes: GitHub's official MCP server for repository, issue, and pull request tools.

entries.name: Playwright MCP
entries.notes: Microsoft's MCP server that lets an agent drive a browser through Playwright.

entries.name: Gemini CLI
entries.notes: Open-source terminal agent that brings Gemini into the shell. API usage is billed by Google.

entries.name: Google ADK
entries.notes: Open-source Agent Development Kit for building, debugging, and deploying agents.

entries.name: Jules
entries.notes: Google's autonomous coding agent that plans a change in a GitHub repo and opens a pull request.

entries.name: OpenAI Codex
entries.notes: OpenAI coding agent for planning, building, reviewing, and shipping code across ChatGPT, the editor, and the terminal.

entries.name: Cursor
entries.notes: AI coding agent and editor for handing tasks to agents inside a repository.

entries.name: LangGraph
entries.notes: Open framework for durable agent workflows, memory, streaming, and human review.

entries.name: CrewAI
entries.notes: Framework and platform for crews of agents that share a task.

entries.name: AutoGen
entries.notes: Microsoft's open programming framework for agentic applications.

entries.name: OpenHands
entries.notes: Open-source coding agent with a cloud option that can work from GitHub issues.
